INSERT INTO gcal_oauth_state (
  id, last_refresh_at, last_refresh_status, last_refresh_error,
  consecutive_failures, updated_at
) VALUES (
  1,
  NOW(),
  '{{ $json.oauth_status }}',
  NULLIF('{{ $json.oauth_error || '' }}', ''),
  CASE WHEN '{{ $json.oauth_status }}' = 'failed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
  last_refresh_at = NOW(),
  last_refresh_status = EXCLUDED.last_refresh_status,
  last_refresh_error = EXCLUDED.last_refresh_error,
  consecutive_failures = 
    CASE 
      WHEN EXCLUDED.last_refresh_status = 'failed' 
      THEN gcal_oauth_state.consecutive_failures + 1 
      ELSE 0 
    END,
  updated_at = NOW();

INSERT INTO gcal_meeting_runs (
  gcal_event_id,
  event_summary,
  event_start,
  event_end,
  attendee_count,
  duration_minutes,
  slack_post_status,
  slack_message_ts,
  slack_error,
  oauth_refresh_attempted,
  oauth_refresh_status,
  oauth_error,
  processed_at
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.gcal_event_id }}',
  '{{ $json.event_summary }}',
  '{{ $json.event_start }}'::timestamptz,
  '{{ $json.event_end }}'::timestamptz,
  {{ $json.attendee_count }},
  {{ $json.duration_minutes }},
  '{{ $json.slack_post_status }}',
  NULLIF('{{ $json.slack_message_ts || "" }}', ''),
  NULLIF('{{ $json.slack_error || "" }}', ''),
  TRUE,
  '{{ $('Detect OAuth Status').first().json.oauth_status }}',
  NULLIF('{{ $('Detect OAuth Status').first().json.oauth_error || "" }}', ''),
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (gcal_event_id) DO UPDATE SET
  slack_post_status = EXCLUDED.slack_post_status,
  slack_message_ts = EXCLUDED.slack_message_ts,
  slack_error = EXCLUDED.slack_error,
  processed_at = EXCLUDED.processed_at;
